title: Sprite Swapper & Image Extractor
description: Two Windows tools for Buu's Fury and The Legacy of Goku II. The Image Extractor pulls sprites out of your ROM as BMP files with a description file, and the Sprite Swapper reinserts edited BMPs into the ROM. Version 1.0.1 adds support for mirrored sprites. Published as a ready-built download only; the source code is not available.
